verdict.rationale: Paxos documents API-driven stablecoin transfers, including a one-call mint-and-transfer orchestration, v2 API asset transfers, and on-chain stablecoin refunds. Status can be tracked by polling Get/List Transfers or through orchestration webhooks that fire on each status transition. The evidence never explicitly shows sending to an arbitrary wallet address, a stored-recipient or address-book object, or defined terminal settlement states. Missing for 10: explicit crypto-withdrawal-to-wallet-address endpoint docs, stored recipient/address book support, documented status lifecycle through final on-chain settlement, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send stablecoin payouts programmatically — pay a wallet address or stored recipient through the API with documented status tracking to final settlement
